dbe_source.recommendation: Point P(x; y) on the unit circle. The sign of x and y depends on which quadrant P is in. Q2: x < 0, y > 0. Q3: x < 0, y < 0. Q4: x > 0, y < 0.

lesson.concept: Point P(x; y) on the unit circle. The sign of x and y depends on which quadrant P is in. Q2: x < 0, y > 0. Q3: x < 0, y < 0. Q4: x > 0, y < 0.
lesson.why: This is one of the most frequent errors DBE reported for this section.

example.problem: P is in Q2 on the unit circle. If y = 0.6, find x.

probe.problem: P is in Q3 on the unit circle. If x = -0.6, find y.

learner_message: The quadrant decides the sign of each coordinate. Q2: x is negative. Q3: both negative. Q4: y is negative.
